entities.name: SLSS Transmission Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to select SLSSID and transmission slot for Sidelink Synchronization Signal transmission in NR sidelink communication.

entities.name: SLSSID
entities.description: Sidelink Synchronization Signal Identifier used for synchronization reference identification.

entities.name: SL-SSB-TimeAllocation
entities.description: Configuration parameters defining slot allocation for SLSS transmission.

entities.name: GNSS as synchronization reference
entities.description: Condition where UE has selected GNSS as synchronization reference according to 5.8.6.2.

entities.name: Cell as synchronization reference
entities.description: Condition where UE has selected a cell as synchronization reference according to 5.8.6.2.

entities.name: SyncRef UE selected
entities.description: Condition where UE has selected a synchronization reference UE.

entities.name: In coverage condition
entities.description: Condition based on inCoverage field in MasterInformationBlockSidelink from SyncRef UE.

entities.name: MasterInformationBlockSidelink
entities.description: Sidelink broadcast message containing synchronization information including inCoverage indicator.

entities.name: SLSS selection behavior
entities.description: UE behavior for selecting SLSSID and transmission slot based on synchronization reference and coverage conditions.

relations.description: SLSS transmission procedure involves selection of SLSSID.
SLSS transmission procedure uses SL-SSB-TimeAllocation parameters for slot selection.
Procedure execution is guarded by GNSS synchronization reference condition.
Procedure execution is guarded by cell synchronization reference condition.
Procedure execution is guarded by SyncRef UE selection condition.
GNSS synchronization reference condition establishes SLSSID 0 selection behavior.
Cell synchronization reference condition establishes SLSSID selection from configured list.
SyncRef UE selection condition requires reception of MasterInformationBlockSidelink message.
In coverage condition establishes same SLSSID selection as SyncRef UE.
